Cela en fait le 2 e pôle économique de la région Nouvelle - Aquitaine. L’EPCI compte plus de 900 agents répartis sur différents sites et exerce notamment les grandes compétences suivantes : aménagement et voirie, développement économique (dont le tourisme), habitat, politique de la ville et insertion professionnelle, mobilité, grands équipements culturels et sportifs (Zénith, L’Aquapolis, Vélodrome Raymond Poulidor), environnement et cadre de vie. Pour assurer l’information et la promotion des services auprès des habitants et usagers dans tous ces domaines, la Direction de la communication utilise différents types de supports, papier ou digitaux, des sites internet, des réseaux sociaux, des vidéos, un magazine communautaire mensuel, des événements et partenariats… Contexte Limoges Métropole dispose de compétences et ressources internes lui permettant de concevoir la plupart de ses supports de communication. Succession On entend ici une succession universelle ou partielle de l’adjudicataire initial, à la suite d’opérations de restructuration de société, notamment de rachat, de fusion, d’acquisition ou d’insolvabilité, assurée par un autre opérateur économique qui remplit les critères de sélection établis initialement, à condition que cela n’entraîne pas d’autres modifications substantielles du marché. Lorsque plusieurs modifications successives sont effectuées, le montant est déterminé sur la base de la valeur cumulée nette des modifications successives. Verklaring aangaande de uitsluitingsgronden en/of selectiecriteria Impliciete verklaring op erewoord Door eenvoudig deel te nemen aan deze procedure tot gunning van de overheidsopdracht en door zijn aanvraag tot deelneming of offerte in te dienen, verklaart de kandidaat of inschrijver op erewoord zich niet in één van de voorziene uitsluitingsgevallen te bevinden als bedoeld in de Art 67, 68 en 69 van de wet. Wat de selectiecriteria betreft moeten de documenten en certificaten ten laatste op het uiterste tijdstip voor de indiening van de aanvragen tot deelneming of de offertes worden voorgelegd. Opmerking: de aanbestedende overheid gaat enkel voor de als opdrachtnemer in aanmerking komende inschrijver na of deze zich effectief niet in één van de voormelde uitsluitingsgevallen bevindt. De aanbestedende overheid zal in deze context een uittreksel strafregister opvragen van de natuurlijke persoon die de offerte/indieningsrapport heeft ondertekend, alsook van de rechtspersoon. Tevens behoudt ze zich het recht voor andere overtuigende stukken op te vragen. Wanneer meerdere ondernemingen deel uitmaakten van een combina

In dat geval legt hij de schriftelijke beschrijving van de genomen maatregelen voor. In het offertebiljet kan melding gemaakt worden van corrigerende maatregelen. Les montants du marché sont précisés au cahier des clauses administratives particulières du marché ainsi qu’à l’acte d’engagement de chaque lot. Le candidat pourra déposer une offre pour un ou plusieurs lot(s). 2-2- Forme juridique de l'attributaire Aucune forme de groupement n'est imposée par l’acheteur public. En cas d’attribution du marché à un groupement conjoint d’entreprises, l’acheteur public imposera que le mandataire du groupement soit solidaire de chacun des opérateurs économiques membres du groupement, conformément à l’article R2142 -24 du Code de la commande publique. certifications_partner.text: erhöht. Konfiguration SSL Um SSL zu aktivieren, wird die benötigte Konfiguration in der Datei /etc/httpd/conf.d/ssl.conf vorgenommen. (MVVM) development pattern, where you would have to code the presentation layer by creating View Models and Views for each object you wish to display, using NOF there is only a set of default generic (MVVM) views defined by NOF and they are applied to all domain objects (models). The Naked Objects pattern was first described formally in Richard Pawson's PhD thesis which includes a thorough investigation of various antecedents and inspirations for the pattern including, for example, the Morphic user interface. Naked Objects is commonly contrasted with the model-view-controller pattern. However, the published version of Pawson's thesis (see References) contains a foreword by Trygve Reenskaug, who first formulated the model-view-controller pattern, suggesting that Naked Objects is closer to the original intent of model-view-controller than many of the subsequent interpretations and implementations. Further information on the NO pattern is available at http://www.nakedobjects.org/ . Naked Objects 2.0 The BOMi currently uses version 2.0 of the Naked Objects framework, referred to as 'NOF2', which was the first publicly available framework to implement the 'naked objects pattern'. La première révision intervient le 1er avril 2028. La révision s’applique tant à la hausse qu’à la baisse. Hier werden auch Name und Anschrift des Wirtschaftsteilnehmers, zu dessen Gunsten der Zuschlag erteilt wurde, veröffentlicht. Im Falle der Einleitung eines Nachprüfungsverfahrens vor der Vergabekammer hat die Vergabestelle nach § 163 Absatz 2 Satz 4 des Gesetzes gegen Wettbewerbsbeschränkungen die Vergabeakten der Kammer sofort zur Verfügung zu stellen. Dies gilt auch für das Ver fahren der sofortigen Be- schwerde vor dem zuständigen Oberlandesgericht nach § 171 GWB. Duration of a supplier’s qualification A supplier's qualification is valid for a term of 5 years. After the 5-year period, the qualification may be extended for the same period after the administrative and/or technical files are updated. Infrabel Procurement sends the supplier an invitation in this regard about 6 months before the qualification's expiry date. The supplier shall submit the new administrative and/or technical file within 2 months. If the supplier does not take timely action, it runs the risk that its qualification extension is not completed before expiry date. Infrabel reserves the right to perform an audit, if this is deemed necessary, before extending the qualification. If these updated files and possible audit show that the supplier still meets the qualification conditions/criteria, the qualification of the supplier concerned will be renewed. The qualified supplier must continue to meet all qualification conditions/criteria throughout the qualification period. Het systeem moet standaardrapporten en realtime dashboards aanbieden en gegevens kunnen exporteren naar gangbare formaten en business intelligence -toepassingen. Dit moet toe laten om wachttijden, no -shows, capaciteit, piekmomenten en andere kernindicatoren efficiënt op te volgen en beleidsmatig te analyseren. De in het systeem opgeslagen data is eigendom van de stad en moet te allen tijde toegankelijk blijven voor de stad. Tot slot worden hoge eisen gesteld op het vlak van gebruiksvriendelijkheid, toegankelijkheid, veiligheid, beheer en toekomstbestendigheid. Een kandidaat mag slechts één aanvraag tot deelneming indienen (indien ingediend wordt als hoofdaannemer of lid van een consortium). Een onderaannemer kan wel onderaannemer zijn voor verschillende offertes. Bestek nr. 16E

Pakkuja peab esitama hankija nõutud andmed/dokumendid 3 (kolme) tööpäeva jooksul. turnover_financial.text: nd ist Gegenstand des Interessenbekundungsverfahrens. Die Attraktivität des Campusnetzes ergibt sich aus seiner etablierten Telekommunikationsinfrastruktur an einem dynamisch wachsenden Hochtechnologiestandort. Das Netz verfügt über eine bestehende Kundenbasis, gewachsene Leitungswege und Netzknoten sowie redundante Carrier-Anbindungen. Zusätzliche Entwicklungsperspektiven ergeben sich aus der fortlaufenden Erweiterung des Campus durch neue Gebäude, dem Ausbaupotenzial für Cloud-, Security- und UCC-Dienste sowie der Ergänzung durch ein lokales 5G-Campusnetz. Damit bietet das Campusnetz eine belastbare infrastrukturelle Grundlage mit weiterem wirtschaftlichem und technologischem Wachstumspotenzial. Die Beweggründe für den Verkauf durch die WISTA sind eine strategische Weiterentwicklung des Campusnetzes durch einen spezialisierten Provider, mit qualifiziertem Personal und dem notwendigen Knowhow. Verkaufsgegenstand Kabelnetz Das WISTA-Campusnetz am Wissenschafts- und Wirtschaftsstandort Adlershof bildet die zentrale Kommunikationsinfrastruktur für Sprach- und Datendienste im Kerngebiet des Technologieparks. Es versorgt derzeit rund 400 Kunden sowie ca. 4.400 Teilnehmer im Voice-Bereich und ist damit ein wesentlicher Standortfaktor für Deutschlands größten Wissenschafts- und Technologiepark. Die vorhandene Infrastruktur umfasst eine leistungsfähige Kabelkanalanlage, ein Leitungsnetz auf Kupfer- und Glasfaserbasis, mit einer Gesamtlänge von knapp 20 Kilometern, sowie ein Gigabit-Ethernet-Backbone. Technisch genutzt werden insbesondere LWL-Backbone-Verbindungen, Monomode- und Multimode-Glasfaserkabel, Kupferkabel, Kupfer-Querkabel sowie FM-Kabel mit 100 Doppeladern. Over the past decade, this ecosystem has expanded organically through project ‑by‑project deployments. As a result, the current environment is characterised by fragmentation, inconsistent branding, duplication of operational and hosting costs, varied technical standards, and increasingly complex governance and content‑management structures. A preliminary mapping exercise conducted by MTA has identified more than thirty (30) digital assets, including consumer‑facing websites, corporate platforms, country‑specific domains (e.g., 14 Unclassified France, Germany, Italy, the UK, Japan, Korea, and others), MICE ‑focused portals, event ‑driven microsites, and international representative sites. These range from high ‑traffic multilingual portals such as VisitMalta.com to legacy campaign sites, temporary market blogs, outdated or abandoned domains, and internal syst

mpaign sites, temporary market blogs, outdated or abandoned domains, and internal systems supporting media management, CRM, B2B services, and training. Social media channels and API ‑based integrations further contribute to the broader content flow and technical landscape. MTA’s strategic direction is to consolidate this extensive and heterogeneous digital landscape under a unified and coherent platform centred around VisitMalta.com. The objective is to improve user experience, reinforce consistent brand representation across all markets, streamline content and technical governance, and reduce long‑term operational, maintenance, and hosting costs. To support this strategic shift, MTA requires a comprehensive Web Environment Analysis and Requirements Definition Exercise. It shall assess the current ecosystem in full, map underlying systems and content flows, identify consolidation and rationalisation opportunities, and define the technical, functional, governance, integration, and procurement requirements. The findings will directly inform the preparation of a public tender, ensuring that the future solution is robust, scalable, interoperable, secure, and aligned with MTA’s long‑term digital transformation strategy. 1.6 - Related Programmes and Donor Activities T

on and adjudication process. Ultimately, the contract will ensure that MTA has the foundations required to implement a future-proof digital platform offering consistent branding, improved user experience, enhanced operational efficiency, and strengthened international visibility. 2.2 - Specific Objectives The objectives of this contract [which are not necessarily those of the project] are as follows: 1. To carry out a complete and validated analysis of MTA’s current digital ecosystem This objective focuses on discovering, mapping, auditing, and assessing all MTA digital assets, including domains, subdomains, microsites, hosting environments, CMS platforms, integrations, 15 Unclassified SEO structures, and compliance obligations. The Consultant must identify shadow sites, legacy components, security vulnerabilities, and operational inefficiencies to establish an authoritative baseline for consolidation. The Consultant shall categorise each asset using a Retain / Migrate / Redesign / Retire model. This objective ensures that strategic, technical, functional, and governance considerations guide which elements of the current web estate are preserved, redesig ned, consolidated, or phased out. 2. The HSE provides thousands of services to young and old, in hospitals, health facilities and in communities across the country. It will draw them in and build on the knowledge and skill acquired in each stage. Programme Aim The purpose of this training programme is to design, develop and deliver a training programme that build people’s understanding of self-harm and the role it plays in the life of a person who self-harms. The programme will build the knowledge and confidence of the learner to have a conversation if they are concerned that someone may be self-harming. The training programme should provide people who access it with a sense of hope and reassurance that people can build healthier coping mechanisms. Programme Objectives The training programme is intended to: Increase understanding of what self-harm is. Increase understanding of the relationship between self-harm and suicide. Build skills and confidence to engage with a person and speak openly about self-harm. Challenge the stigma surrounding self-harm Increase awareness of available supports and services Stage 1: An introduction to the subject of self-harm – communicating the ‘why’ functions of self-harm through lived experience experts. REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST

(CONSULTING SERVICES - FIRMS SELECTION)

Project Name: Eastern Africa Regional Statistics Program-for-Results (EARSPforR)

Project ID: P176371

Assignment Title: Consultancy Services for Development of Animated Video Content with Infographics, Data Visualizations and Voice-over Narration for EAC Online Statistics Learning Materials

Reference No.: TZ-EAC-564358-CS-CQS

1. BACKGROUND

The East African Community (EAC) Secretariat is implementing the EAC component of the Eastern Africa Regional Statistics Program-for-Results (EARSPforR), with financing from the World Bank. The Program seeks to strengthen the production, harmonization, dissemination, and use of quality economic and social statistics in Eastern Africa.

Under EARSPforR, the EAC Secretariat has developed online learning materials in fourteen priority statistical domains for use by Partner State institutions and other data users. Although technically sound, many of the materials are text-heavy an

. The videos will incorporate infographics, accurate data visualizations, professional voice-over narration, captions, and transcripts, and will be suitable for the EAC Learning Management System, websites, and mobile access.

The assignment will be completed within a maximum of ten weeks from contract commencement. The principal deliverables will include an inception report and production plan; scripts, storyboards, and visual style; a pilot video; a complete draft video package; and final master, LMS/mobile, caption, transcript, thumbnail, editable-source-file, asset/licence, and completion-report packages.

The detailed Terms of Reference for the assignment can be accessed at www.eac.int under Procurement/Consultancies.

The Secretariat intends to engage a qualified consulting firm to develop new multimedia content where explanation gaps exist and to transform selected approved learning materials into concise animated videos. The videos will incorporate infographics, accurate data visualizations, professional voice-over narration, captions, and transcripts, and will be suitable for the EAC Learning Management System, websites, and mobile access.

The assignment will be completed within a maximum of ten weeks from contract commencement. The principal deliverables will include an inception report and production plan; scripts, storyboards, and visual style; a pilot video; a complete draft video package; and final master, LMS/mobile, caption, transcript, thumbnail, editable-source-file, asset/licence, and completion-report packages.

The detailed Terms of Reference for the assignment can be accessed at www.eac.int under Procurement/Consultancies.

entity_geography.text: Performance Successful performance will be an essential feature of work awarded under the Panel. Poor performance will be identified and raised with panel members and may result in termination of a contract and/or removal from the panel. Evaluation Criteria for Admittance to the Panel Application Requirements The Contracting Authority is using a process similar to the OPEN procedure for the establishment of this panel, therefore, while all interested parties may apply, only those demonstrating that they have the required level of qualifications, experience and technical capacity will have their application considered. In order to demonstrate eligibility, applicants are required to provide the following information: General Information Including the following information: Name of applicant Address Key contact name Key contact email Key contact phone / mobile Website if applicable Other social media platform activities Date of establishment Insurance Requirements Confirmation of insurances in place and commitment to put the following levels in place if successful for the contract: Must provide evidence of this level of cover being in place or a letter from an Insurance company stating that these levels of cover may be put in place if a contract is awarded within one week of the appointment

Use of the Panel The Contracting Authority will use this panel as and when requirements within its scope arise. The Government will pay the Contractor on a monthly basis for routine services that have been satisfactorily performed. The Contractor shall ensure that all services are delivered with high availability, reliability, and performance consistent with commercial best practices for enterprise telecommunications services. The Contractor shall offer two different plans to fulfill the Government needs: Basic Plan. Pay per use for actual calls (local, local long distance, international long distance), incoming and outgoing roaming calls, incoming and outgoing local SMS, incoming and outgoing international SMS, incoming and outgoing roaming SMS. Unlimited Smart Phones & Tablets Plan. A flat monthly rate per cellphone line that includes unlimited: local data, local minutes on-net, local minutes off-net, national long-distance minutes,

Teikdamas paraišką CVP IS priemonėmis šį užpildytą ir pasirašytą (išskyrus tuos atvejus, kai visą paraišką elektroniniu parašu pasirašo EBVPD turintis pasirašyti asmuo) EBVPD tiekėjas turi pateikti kartu su kitais paraiškos dokumentais. 14.3. EBVPD nurodytą informaciją pagrindžiantys dokumentai. 14.4. Below please find a set of clarifications, which are construed to form an integral part of the tender document. Question 1 Estimate Quantity in Hours Per Year If I don't complete the hours estimated in the Financial bid, do these go over to the following year? Answer 1 As per Tender dossier: - Section 3 – Terms of Reference - 3) Assumptions and Risks - 3.2) Risks (a) The number of working hours per month may vary according to the needs that might arise. This capability must allow operators to identify and prioritize interoperability issues and potential workarounds within a single system. • 3.1.3.2 Platform Issue Tracking: The software shall provide a mechanism to record and maintain a history of platform-specific issues (e.g., design, testing, operational) through their entire lifecycle. This information must be linked to the platform specification to enable automatic updates to existing analyses. • 3.1.3.3 Capabilities & Limitations Summary: The software shall be capable of generating a consolidated, high-level summary of a platform's TDL capabilities, including implemented TDLs, message baselines, equipment fits, and network capabilities (e.g., Link 22, JREAP). 3.1.4 Interoperability (IO) Evaluation: The software shall provide a robust module to conduct detailed, multi-platform IO evaluations. When preparing a competitive quotation, vendors should take into consideration benefits provided through the national healthcare system. Quotations should refrain from over customization, and should be “off the shelf”, “commercially available”, or “market ready” products which are designed to be complementary and supplement to the national system in Portugal. The benefit levels listed from section C.1.1 through C.1.24 are a standard package that must be provided. C.1.1 Eligibility: To be eligible to participate in the medical plan, LE Staff (both full time and part time) must be: -- Paid under the terms of the Local Compensation Plan (LCP); and – -- Under a non-temporary direct hire appointment, personal services agreement (PSA), or personal services contract (PSC); or -- Under a temporary direct hire appointment or PSA Fixed Term of one year or more. Not eligible are those working under temporary appointments; those working under a PSC or PSA that is time limited to less than one year; non-personal services contract personnel and their employees, supplied by an independent contractor l

ointments; those working under a PSC or PSA that is time limited to less than one year; non-personal services contract personnel and their employees, supplied by an independent contractor licensed to do business in Portugal who provides services to other local RFP 19GE5026Q0035 – LES Health Insurance Services for U.S. Embassy Lisbon Page 6 of 21 organizations as well as to the U.S. Mission; employees working on an intermittent or When Actually Employed (WAE) schedule; Peace Corps personal services contractors and Recreation Association employees. C.1.2 Riders: There are no riders under this contract. C.1.3 Periods of Ineligibility: Employees and their dependents are not entitled to health benefits during any period of employment for which premiums are not paid. Additionally, employee's dependents are not entitled to health benefits during any period of employment during which the employee was not eligible to participate. During a period of extended Leave Without Pay (LWOP) or other unpaid leave beyond one pay period, the employee is responsible for the full cost of the insurance premiums for self and dependents. The Mission will pay the premiums directly to the Contractor and will collect the full cost from the employee on a quarterly basis. Alternatively

Bestalde, kontratu publikoen prezioen berrikuspenari buruzko arauak egokitzen dira Espainiako Ekonomiaren Desindexazioaren martxoaren 30eko 2/2015 Legean ezarritakoaren arabera, halako moduz non prezioak ez diren berrikusiko adierazle orokorren bitartez, baizik eta berariazko adierazleen bitartez, zeinek kontratatutako prestazioaren kostuaren osagaiak islatzen dituzten formulen bitartez operatuko baitute. II. liburuan, kontratuen prestaketari buruzko atalaren barruan, merkatuari buruzko aldez aurretiko kontsulten erregulazioa sartzen da, lizitazioa zuzen prestatzeko eta operadore ekonomikoei informazioa emateko kasuko organoaren kontratazio-planei buruz eta prozeduran aurkezteko exijituko diren baldintzei buruz. Aztergai diren obra, produktu, zerbitzu, prozesu edo prozedurek zenbait baldintza betetzen dituztela berresten dituzten egiaztatze-bide berrien araupetzea zabaltzen da, eta, horretarako, hemen etiketa berriak, froga-txostenak, ziurtagiriak eta bestelako bitartekoak sartzen dira.

Lorsque plusieurs modifications successives sont effectuées, le montant est déterminé sur la base de la valeur cumulée nette des modifications successives. Verklaring aangaande de uitsluitingsgronden en/of selectiecriteria Impliciete verklaring op erewoord Door eenvoudig deel te nemen aan deze procedure tot gunning van de overheidsopdracht en door zijn aanvraag tot deelneming of offerte in te dienen, verklaart de kandidaat of inschrijver op erewoord zich niet in één van de voorziene uitsluitingsgevallen te bevinden als bedoeld in de Art 67, 68 en 69 van de wet. Wat de selectiecriteria betreft moeten de documenten en certificaten ten laatste op het uiterste tijdstip voor de indiening van de aanvragen tot deelneming of de offertes worden voorgelegd. Opmerking: de aanbestedende overheid gaat enkel voor de als opdrachtnemer in aanmerking komende inschrijver na of deze zich effectief niet in één van de voormelde uitsluitingsgevallen bevindt. De aanbestedende overheid zal in deze context een uittreksel strafregister opvragen van de natuurlijke persoon die de offerte/indieningsrapport heeft ondertekend, alsook van de rechtspersoon. Tevens behoudt ze zich het recht voor andere overtuigende stukken op te vragen. Wanneer meerdere ondernemingen deel uitmaakten van een combina

In dat geval legt hij de schriftelijke beschrijving van de genomen maatregelen voor. In het offertebiljet kan melding gemaakt worden van corrigerende maatregelen. Wildfly starten, stoppen und Status abfragen Mit sysemctl kann der Wildfly gestartet und gestoppt werden und es kann der aktuelle Status überprüft werden. (MVVM) development pattern, where you would have to code the presentation layer by creating View Models and Views for each object you wish to display, using NOF there is only a set of default generic (MVVM) views defined by NOF and they are applied to all domain objects (models). The Naked Objects pattern was first described formally in Richard Pawson's PhD thesis which includes a thorough investigation of various antecedents and inspirations for the pattern including, for example, the Morphic user interface. Naked Objects is commonly contrasted with the model-view-controller pattern. However, the published version of Pawson's thesis (see References) contains a foreword by Trygve Reenskaug, who first formulated the model-view-controller pattern, suggesting that Naked Objects is closer to the original intent of model-view-controller than many of the subsequent interpretations and implementations. Further information on the NO pattern is available at http://www.nakedobjects.org/ . Naked Objects 2.0 The BOMi currently uses version 2.0 of the Naked Objects framework, referred to as 'NOF2', which was the first publicly available framework to implement the 'naked objects pattern'. NOF2 was originally written by Naked Objects Group and supplied to the Department under an open-source licence.

The information contained within this Schedule is intended to provide an understanding of the current technology estate, user environment, applications, infrastructure, services and operational landscape. It is provided to assist Tenderers in developing an informed technical and commercial proposal and to minimise the need for assumptions. The information contained within this Schedule is indicative of the current ICT environment and should not be interpreted as limiting the Tenderer's ability to propose alternative approaches, technologies or service improvements where these better support the objectives of the Contracting Authority

La révision s’applique tant à la hausse qu’à la baisse. Les prix relatifs aux prestations d’implémentation, de migration, de reprise des données, de mise en exploitation et de formation exécutées dans le cadre de l’étape 1 ne font pas l’objet d’une révision. VHB-Bbg Formular 3.11 EU Stand: 07/2022 Information nach EU-Datenschutz-Grundverordnung (DSGVO) 4 Nach § 39 Absatz 1 Vergabeverordnung übermittelt die Vergabestelle spätestens 30 Tage nach der Vergabe eines öffentlichen Auftrags oder nach dem Abschluss einer Rahmenvereinbarung eine Vergabebekanntmachung mit den Ergebnissen des Vergabeverfahrens an das Amt für Veröffentli- chungen der Europäischen Union. Hier werden auch Name und Anschrift des Wirtschaftsteilnehmers, zu dessen Gunsten der Zuschlag erteilt wurde, veröffentlicht. Im Falle der Einleitung eines Nachprüfungsverfahrens vor der Vergabekammer hat die Vergabestelle nach § 163 Absatz 2 Satz 4 des Gesetzes gegen Wettbewerbsbeschränkungen die Vergabeakten der Kammer sofort zur Verfügung zu stellen. Dies gilt auch für das Ver fahren der sofortigen Be- schwerde vor dem zuständigen Oberlandesgericht nach § 171 GWB. In diesen Verfahren werden personenbezogene Daten ggf. auch an andere Verfahrensbeteiligte weitergegeben. 5. Duration of a supplier’s qualification A supplier's qualification is valid for a term of 5 years. After the 5-year period, the qualification may be extended for the same period after the administrative and/or technical files are updated. Infrabel Procurement sends the supplier an invitation in this regard about 6 months before the qualification's expiry date. The supplier shall submit the new administrative and/or technical file within 2 months. If the supplier does not take timely action, it runs the risk that its qualification extension is not completed before expiry date. Infrabel reserves the right to perform an audit, if this is deemed necessary, before extending the qualification. If these updated files and possible audit show that the supplier still meets the qualification conditions/criteria, the qualification of the supplier concerned will be renewed. The qualified supplier must continue to meet all qualification conditions/criteria throughout the qualification period. Het systeem moet standaardrapporten en realtime dashboards aanbieden en gegevens kunnen exporteren naar gangbare formaten en business intelligence -toepassingen. Dit moet toe laten om wachttijden, no -shows, capaciteit, piekmomenten en andere kernindicatoren efficiënt op te volgen en beleidsmatig te analyseren. De in het systeem opgeslagen data is eigendom van de stad en moet te allen tijde toegankelijk blijven voor de stad. Tot slot worden hoge eisen gesteld op het vlak van gebruiksvriendelijkheid, toegankelijkheid, veiligheid, beheer en toekomstbestendigheid. Een kandidaat mag slechts één aanvraag tot deelneming indienen (indien ingediend wordt als hoofdaannemer of lid van een consortium). Een onderaannemer kan wel onderaannemer zijn voor verschillende offertes. Bestek nr. 16E

Pakkuja peab esitama hankija nõutud andmed/dokumendid 3 (kolme) tööpäeva jooksul. turnover_financial.text: nd ist Gegenstand des Interessenbekundungsverfahrens. Die Attraktivität des Campusnetzes ergibt sich aus seiner etablierten Telekommunikationsinfrastruktur an einem dynamisch wachsenden Hochtechnologiestandort. Das Netz verfügt über eine bestehende Kundenbasis, gewachsene Leitungswege und Netzknoten sowie redundante Carrier-Anbindungen. Zusätzliche Entwicklungsperspektiven ergeben sich aus der fortlaufenden Erweiterung des Campus durch neue Gebäude, dem Ausbaupotenzial für Cloud-, Security- und UCC-Dienste sowie der Ergänzung durch ein lokales 5G-Campusnetz. Damit bietet das Campusnetz eine belastbare infrastrukturelle Grundlage mit weiterem wirtschaftlichem und technologischem Wachstumspotenzial. Die Beweggründe für den Verkauf durch die WISTA sind eine strategische Weiterentwicklung des Campusnetzes durch einen spezialisierten Provider, mit qualifiziertem Personal und dem notwendigen Knowhow. Verkaufsgegenstand Kabelnetz Das WISTA-Campusnetz am Wissenschafts- und Wirtschaftsstandort Adlershof bildet die zentrale Kommunikationsinfrastruktur für Sprach- und Datendienste im Kerngebiet des Technologieparks. Es versorgt derzeit rund 400 Kunden sowie ca. 4.400 Teilnehmer im Voice-Bereich und ist damit ein wesentlicher Standortfaktor für Deutschlands größten Wissenschafts- und Technologiepark. Die vorhandene Infrastruktur umfasst eine leistungsfähige Kabelkanalanlage, ein Leitungsnetz auf Kupfer- und Glasfaserbasis, mit einer Gesamtlänge von knapp 20 Kilometern, sowie ein Gigabit-Ethernet-Backbone. Technisch genutzt werden insbesondere LWL-Backbone-Verbindungen, Monomode- und Multimode-Glasfaserkabel, Kupferkabel, Kupfer-Querkabel sowie FM-Kabel mit 100 Doppeladern. Over the past decade, this ecosystem has expanded organically through project ‑by‑project deployments. As a result, the current environment is characterised by fragmentation, inconsistent branding, duplication of operational and hosting costs, varied technical standards, and increasingly complex governance and content‑management structures. A preliminary mapping exercise conducted by MTA has identified more than thirty (30) digital assets, including consumer‑facing websites, corporate platforms, country‑specific domains (e.g., 14 Unclassified France, Germany, Italy, the UK, Japan, Korea, and others), MICE ‑focused portals, event ‑driven microsites, and international representative sites. These range from high ‑traffic multilingual portals such as VisitMalta.com to legacy campaign sites, temporary market blogs, outdated or abandoned domains, and internal syst

mpaign sites, temporary market blogs, outdated or abandoned domains, and internal systems supporting media management, CRM, B2B services, and training. Social media channels and API ‑based integrations further contribute to the broader content flow and technical landscape. MTA’s strategic direction is to consolidate this extensive and heterogeneous digital landscape under a unified and coherent platform centred around VisitMalta.com. The objective is to improve user experience, reinforce consistent brand representation across all markets, streamline content and technical governance, and reduce long‑term operational, maintenance, and hosting costs. To support this strategic shift, MTA requires a comprehensive Web Environment Analysis and Requirements Definition Exercise. It shall assess the current ecosystem in full, map underlying systems and content flows, identify consolidation and rationalisation opportunities, and define the technical, functional, governance, integration, and procurement requirements. The findings will directly inform the preparation of a public tender, ensuring that the future solution is robust, scalable, interoperable, secure, and aligned with MTA’s long‑term digital transformation strategy. 1.6 - Related Programmes and Donor Activities T

on and adjudication process. Ultimately, the contract will ensure that MTA has the foundations required to implement a future-proof digital platform offering consistent branding, improved user experience, enhanced operational efficiency, and strengthened international visibility. 2.2 - Specific Objectives The objectives of this contract [which are not necessarily those of the project] are as follows: 1. To carry out a complete and validated analysis of MTA’s current digital ecosystem This objective focuses on discovering, mapping, auditing, and assessing all MTA digital assets, including domains, subdomains, microsites, hosting environments, CMS platforms, integrations, 15 Unclassified SEO structures, and compliance obligations. The Consultant must identify shadow sites, legacy components, security vulnerabilities, and operational inefficiencies to establish an authoritative baseline for consolidation. The Consultant shall categorise each asset using a Retain / Migrate / Redesign / Retire model. This objective ensures that strategic, technical, functional, and governance considerations guide which elements of the current web estate are preserved, redesig ned, consolidated, or phased out. 2. The HSE provides thousands of services to young and old, in hospitals, health facilities and in communities across the country. It will draw them in and build on the knowledge and skill acquired in each stage. Programme Aim The purpose of this training programme is to design, develop and deliver a training programme that build people’s understanding of self-harm and the role it plays in the life of a person who self-harms. The programme will build the knowledge and confidence of the learner to have a conversation if they are concerned that someone may be self-harming. The training programme should provide people who access it with a sense of hope and reassurance that people can build healthier coping mechanisms. Programme Objectives The training programme is intended to: Increase understanding of what self-harm is. Increase understanding of the relationship between self-harm and suicide. Build skills and confidence to engage with a person and speak openly about self-harm. Challenge the stigma surrounding self-harm Increase awareness of available supports and services Stage 1: An introduction to the subject of self-harm – communicating the ‘why’ functions of self-harm through lived experience experts. Project Name: Eastern Africa Regional Statistics Program-for-Results (EARSPforR)

Project ID: P176371

Assignment Title: Consultancy Services for Development of Animated Video Content with Infographics, Data Visualizations and Voice-over Narration for EAC Online Statistics Learning Materials

Reference No.: TZ-EAC-564358-CS-CQS

1. BACKGROUND

The East African Community (EAC) Secretariat is implementing the EAC component of the Eastern Africa Regional Statistics Program-for-Results (EARSPforR), with financing from the World Bank. The Program seeks to strengthen the production, harmonization, dissemination, and use of quality economic and social statistics in Eastern Africa.

Under EARSPforR, the EAC Secretariat has developed online learning materials in fourteen priority statistical domains for use by Partner State institutions and other data users. Although technically sound, many of the materials are text-heavy an

. The videos will incorporate infographics, accurate data visualizations, professional voice-over narration, captions, and transcripts, and will be suitable for the EAC Learning Management System, websites, and mobile access.

The assignment will be completed within a maximum of ten weeks from contract commencement. The detailed Terms of Reference for the assignment can be accessed at www.eac.int under Procurement/Consultancies.

learner engagement, accessibility, and understanding, particularly among non-specialist audiences.

The Secretariat intends to engage a qualified consulting firm to develop new multimedia content where explanation gaps exist and to transform selected approved learning materials into concise animated videos. The videos will incorporate infographics, accurate data visualizations, professional voice-over narration, captions, and transcripts, and will be suitable for the EAC Learning Management System, websites, and mobile access.

The assignment will be completed within a maximum of ten weeks from contract commencement. The principal deliverables will include an inception report and production plan; scripts, storyboards, and visual style; a pilot video; a complete draft video package; and final master, LMS/mobile, caption, transcript, thumbnail, editable-source-file, asset/licence, and completion-report packages.

The detailed Terms of Reference for the assignment can be accessed at www.eac.int under Procurement/Consultancies.

entity_geography.text: Performance Successful performance will be an essential feature of work awarded under the Panel. Poor performance will be identified and raised with panel members and may result in termination of a contract and/or removal from the panel. Evaluation Criteria for Admittance to the Panel Application Requirements The Contracting Authority is using a process similar to the OPEN procedure for the establishment of this panel, therefore, while all interested parties may apply, only those demonstrating that they have the required level of qualifications, experience and technical capacity will have their application considered. In order to demonstrate eligibility, applicants are required to provide the following information: General Information Including the following information: Name of applicant Address Key contact name Key contact email Key contact phone / mobile Website if applicable Other social media platform activities Date of establishment Insurance Requirements Confirmation of insurances in place and commitment to put the following levels in place if successful for the contract: Must provide evidence of this level of cover being in place or a letter from an Insurance company stating that these levels of cover may be put in place if a contract is awarded within one week of the appointment

Use of the Panel The Contracting Authority will use this panel as and when requirements within its scope arise. The Government will pay the Contractor on a monthly basis for routine services that have been satisfactorily performed. The Contractor shall ensure that all services are delivered with high availability, reliability, and performance consistent with commercial best practices for enterprise telecommunications services. The Contractor shall offer two different plans to fulfill the Government needs: Basic Plan. Pay per use for actual calls (local, local long distance, international long distance), incoming and outgoing roaming calls, incoming and outgoing local SMS, incoming and outgoing international SMS, incoming and outgoing roaming SMS. Teikdamas paraišką CVP IS priemonėmis šį užpildytą ir pasirašytą (išskyrus tuos atvejus, kai visą paraišką elektroniniu parašu pasirašo EBVPD turintis pasirašyti asmuo) EBVPD tiekėjas turi pateikti kartu su kitais paraiškos dokumentais. 14.3. EBVPD nurodytą informaciją pagrindžiantys dokumentai. 14.4. Below please find a set of clarifications, which are construed to form an integral part of the tender document. Question 1 Estimate Quantity in Hours Per Year If I don't complete the hours estimated in the Financial bid, do these go over to the following year? Answer 1 As per Tender dossier: - Section 3 – Terms of Reference - 3) Assumptions and Risks - 3.2) Risks (a) The number of working hours per month may vary according to the needs that might arise. Does online application support count as work? This capability must allow operators to identify and prioritize interoperability issues and potential workarounds within a single system. • 3.1.3.2 Platform Issue Tracking: The software shall provide a mechanism to record and maintain a history of platform-specific issues (e.g., design, testing, operational) through their entire lifecycle. This information must be linked to the platform specification to enable automatic updates to existing analyses. • 3.1.3.3 Capabilities & Limitations Summary: The software shall be capable of generating a consolidated, high-level summary of a platform's TDL capabilities, including implemented TDLs, message baselines, equipment fits, and network capabilities (e.g., Link 22, JREAP). 3.1.4 Interoperability (IO) Evaluation: The software shall provide a robust module to conduct detailed, multi-platform IO evaluations.
